title: Relabeled acceptance constraints
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. Relabel the two acceptance unit clauses by assigning the encoding bits consecutive natural-number indices; the clauses require the state to be absent and the summary bit indexed by false to be true.
